subject: DataForge workshop trial top-ups and promo codes

Cc: DataForge Events <events@dataforge.io>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Workshop follow-up: request for attendee trial top-ups and promo codes

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for sponsoring the DataForge "ModelOps in Production" workshop last week — the session was well-received and we had about 230 attendees (hybrid). A handful of enterprise attendees asked about trying Redwood in a hands-on way.

Two quick asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide 200 small trial top-ups (100 credits each) that we can distribute to attendees who want to try the platform?
- Would you be open to extending the standard 30-day trial to 45 days for signups that come through the DataForge referral link? We find a slightly longer window helps adoption after multi-step procurement.

Attached is the sponsor agenda and a stub of the attendee list (no PII). Ideally we would get promo codes or a CSV export we can hand out by next Wednesday (2026-10-21).

Happy to jump on a quick call to clarify.

Best,
Alex Tully
Partnerships Lead | DataForge
Alex.tully@dataforge.io

--
Attachments: DataForge_Sponsor_Agenda.pdf, attendee_stub.csv

Marissa, Vivek — forwarding a partner ask from DataForge.

Summary: they want 200 trial top-ups (100 credits each) and a 45-day trial window for referrals. They need codes/CSV by next Wed (10/21).

My thoughts: we can probably fulfill 150 codes from the marketing promo bucket quickly; the additional 50 would come from partner/credits pool (billing sign-off required). Happy to accept 45-day referral extension for these partner-referred signups if we gate to accounts under $X/month or with basic verification.

Could you confirm:
- Marissa: marketing ok to allocate 150 promo codes and handle distribution?
- Vivek: can we approve the 45-day extension and the extra 50 credits from partnership reserves? If finance needs to review, please loop them.

I'll hold on responding to Alex until we have a quick yes/no and a file (CSV) to hand them.

Thanks,
Priya
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

+1 to fulfilling most of this. Marketing can produce 150 one-time promo codes (100-credit top-ups) from the events pool and generate a CSV.

For the trial window: I support a 45-day extension but would prefer we scope it to accounts that do not exceed our free tier abuse signals (i.e., require a valid company email and no prior Redwood usage). We should also add a flag in HubSpot to tag these "DataForge-referral" signups for a follow-up sequence.

I'll coordinate with growth ops to prep the CSV and messaging. If Vivek confirms the extra 50 credits from the partner bucket, we can hand Alex the full 200 codes by 10/21.

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Growth Marketing | Redwood Inference

- 150 promo codes (100 credits each) from Marketing events pool
- 50 promo codes (100 credits each) approved from Partner Credits reserve

- Trial window: extended to 45 days for accounts created via the DataForge referral link; marketing will tag these signups in HubSpot as "DataForge-referral" for a follow-up cadence.

I've asked Growth Ops to generate the promo_codes_20261020.csv and attached it here. Please note codes expire 2027-01-31. If you need a DocuSign or formal addendum, reply and we can route to Legal.

Next steps for Alex:
1) Accept allocation below by reply-all.
2) Distribute codes to attendees and confirm when distributed (so we can monitor redemptions).
3) Share any attendee companies that look like strategic prospects and we'll prioritize outreach.

Thanks and looking forward to continued partnership.
